text.text_excerpt: Great food, great prices and such friendly staff. Take the drive down Jeff Hwy and go to the Breakfast Club. There was nothing bad on the table. Eggs, cooked perfectly.. Chicken Fried steak, full of Americana Goodness. Potatoes, fried perfectly.. Didn't get the coffee, I usually bring my own. Give it a try, you'll be glad you did..

Went here on the suggestion of Danon H. and I'm glad that I did. It's basically your typical diner fare as previously stated, but with a few welcome surprises. First of all, you can get a Breakfast Bacon Burger w/ hash browns and eggs,which is what I got, for all of those of us who like a good diner burger but seem to only be at one in the a.m. Another great thing about this place is the omelette selection as well as the specials. The menu offers alot to choose from and everything seems pretty good here. I was in the mood for some breakfast so I decided to give this place a try. It is your typical greasy spoon neighborhood diner. You can tell that most of the people that frequent this joint are regulars. All the waitress knew most of the customers by name. They could immediately tell right away that I was a new face. But none the less they were still very friendly towards me. When I ordered my food I got the french toast combo. That entailed a couple of eggs, hash browns, 2 sausage patties,and 3 slices of french toast cut in half. The hash browns were good, and so were the sausage patties.The french toast was very good!
